title: 4 Days Ol Doinyo Lengai Volcano Trek & Great Wild Safari
description: Embark on a 4-day adventure combining trekking Africa’s only active volcano, Ol Doinyo Lengai, with thrilling wildlife safaris in Tarangire and Ngorongoro Crater. Explore dramatic volcanic landscapes, spot elephants, lions, zebras, and wildebeest, and experience Tanzania’s stunning scenery and rich culture for an unforgettable adventure.
highlights: Trek Ol Doinyo Lengai, the sacred Maasai volcano and the only active carbonatite volcano in the world.
Enjoy a full-day game drive in Tarangire National Park, known for massive elephant herds and ancient baobabs.
Explore the world-famous Ngorongoro Crater, home to the Big Five and stunning crater landscapes.
Discover the surreal beauty of Lake Natron, with flamingo breeding grounds and colorful mineral-rich waters.
Visit Ngare Sero waterfalls for refreshing swimming and relaxation.
Engage in an authentic cultural activity in Mto wa Mbu, interacting with local communities.
Experience a perfect blend of trekking, wildlife viewing, and cultural immersion.
includes: 4×4 safari jeep with pop-up roof for game viewing
Bottled drinking water throughout the safari
Cultural activities in Mto wa Mbu
excludes: Optional activities not mentioned in the itinerary

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park Experience
itinerary.text: Pick up from your hotel in Arusha at 7:30 AM and drive three hours to Tarangire National Park. Enjoy a full-day game drive across its diverse landscapes, spotting elephants, lions, leopards, cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and abundant birdlife. Take in the park’s iconic baobab trees and the Tarangire River, which draws large numbers of animals during the dry season, before heading to your lodge or camp for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Experience
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day game drive. Explore the crater floor and its rich ecosystem while encountering the Big Five—lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino—as well as zebras, wildebeest, and flamingos. Lunch is served inside the crater, and after 6–7 hours of immersive wildlife viewing, ascend back to your accommodation for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lake Natron & Ol Doinyo Lengai Trek
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Lake Natron, traveling through the East African Rift Valley and passing traditional Maasai villages. Arrive at Ngare Sero, the gateway to Lake Natron, a breeding haven for millions of flamingos and a spectacular natural landscape. Explore the lake’s shores, visit nearby waterfalls, and prepare for the midnight ascent of Ol Doinyo Lengai, Africa’s only active volcano. Overnight stay is at an African Safari Camp at Lake Natron.

itinerary.title: Descent from Ol Doinyo Lengai & Return to Arusha
itinerary.text: Descend from Ol Doinyo Lengai after an exhilarating hike and enjoy breakfast at the camp. Later, engage in a cultural activity near Mto wa Mbu, interacting with local communities and learning about their traditions. Continue the drive back to Arusha, where the tour concludes with either a transfer for departure or an optional overnight stay, depending on your travel plans. For those flying out the same day, ensure a late evening flight for comfort.

summary: Embark on a 4-day adventure combining trekking Africa’s only active volcano, Ol Doinyo Lengai, with thrilling wildlife safaris in Tarangire and Ngorongoro Crater.
